verdict.rationale: Authoring web components is a fair axis for a UI framework, so it applies. However, the evidence only documents React's own component model (JSX, createRoot, composing React components). Nothing shows authoring standards-based custom elements or Web Components, and React components are a related but different feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author standards-based web components and custom elements using the framework
